title: Family friendly guide in Barcelona
text: David’s tour was the highlight of our trip! We were with him for a full day and I don’t feel like it was enough. We had a group of ten, 4 adults and. 6 kids from Louisville, KY. We did a walking tour of the Gothic quarter that really gave us a full perspective on the city, stopped for great local food and drink along the way and then ended the day with Sagrada Família tour. His passion for the city and sharing the culture shown through! Our favorite highlights were the Roman Ruins, conversation over tapas, and finding the Sant Jordi dragons. title: Best Guide in Spain!
text: David is one of the best guides we have hired!  He is so knowledgeable and personable.  You feel like you are traveling with a friend.  He made our time in Barcelona so meaningful.  We could not give him a higher recommendation
author: Roam793486

title: Key takeaway:  Must get...
text:
Key takeaway:  Must get Nestor as your guide.  
While tour is a bit pricey, he made it all worthwhile.  Unfortunately, we visited Barcelona during one of the rainiest periods in recent history - but it really didn't make a difference as our guide made the city come alive for us.  Not only did we get a full Gaudi experience, but the tour of the old city offered a counterpoint to the architect that has grabbed everyone's attention. title: Amazing tour you must do it
text: Everything was amazing - I spent along time wondering what was my favourite bit. But I think I loved it all for different reasons - you just have to se it all. David was an amazing guide and gave us the right amount of time and information in all the  places. - The world is just such a beautiful place and a david showed us this beauty though his eyes and knowledge ( he also knew all the best places to eat - YUM )
author: Jackie P

title: Unforgettable memories
text: David Chacon was referred to me by a good friend who spent several weeks in Barcelona, so we connected by email with David prior to our trip. David made it a point to be completely connected to us prior to our pickup and we spent the entire day listening to him tell us the history of everything we saw. He speaks perfect English and was so very easy to be with! Our biggest and most memorable of that tour is definitely La Sagrada Familia!!! David took pictures of us inside the cathedral that will make a perfect Christmas card!! He is definitely a fabulous tour guide!!!
author: K8700QCcandys

title: Great day in Barcelona
text: David was a wonderful,  fun, knowledgeable and accommodating guide. He did a great job balancing facts with humour. He matched the tour to our interests and energy levels. Nothing was a problem. Highly recommend 👌
author: VibrantWomenTravel

title: The best of Barcelona
text: David gave us a fabulous 10 hour tour with so many highlights of the city. We sampled amazing seafood and other food for lunch. This was the best way to see so much of the beautiful city of Barcelona with such limited time.
